name: replit_morph_extension
parent_card: studio/mcp/replit-bridge/server.py (no existing replit_bridge agent_def card present — this sidecar documents the extension; freetier_public_deploy.active.json is NOT modified)
summary: Additive extension to the existing unified MCP bridge at studio/mcp/replit-bridge/server.py. Registers three new tools in the existing TOOLS dispatch dict: replit:deploy_morphing_game, replit:mint_token_on_deploy, replit:link_snap_lens_to_repl. All three are bolted onto the morphing-game stack (morph_game_runtime.ScenePlan, solana_mcp.SolanaMCPConnector, snap_camera_kit.SnapCameraKitConnector) which are being built in parallel by agents G, D, and B respectively. Every dependency is lazy-imported so the bridge degrades gracefully when a parallel build has not landed yet. The existing 18+ tools in TOOLS are NOT modified. The existing FastAPI app, deploy-to-droplet.sh, Caddyfile, and systemd unit are NOT touched — the existing POST /tools/{tool_name} route automatically picks up the new entries.
engine_pattern: Three new entries are appended at the end of the existing TOOLS = {...} registry in server.py. The dispatcher routes POST /tools/replit:deploy_morphing_game (etc.) to the existing handler-lambda pattern. Helpers live in a clearly-delimited block AFTER the TOOLS dict, prefixed with '_replit_'. Each helper performs sys.path.insert + lazy import of its third-party connector and returns a serialisable dict. Crystal anchors are emitted via core.lib.inference_logger.InferenceLogger.log(...). When inference_logger is not importable the crystal_id silently returns '' so the tool never breaks. lens_routes.json starts as {} and is read/written by replit:link_snap_lens_to_repl as a stdlib-json store.

replit:deploy_morphing_game.behaviour: Loads studio/assets/_workflows/<slug>.json (also tries vm_mspc_001.workflows.<slug>.v0.json), packages an HTML5 build referencing studio/godot/scenes/morphing_game.tscn + core/lib/morph_game_runtime.py, reuses an existing generate_app / replit:generate_app / myspace:generate_app tool if registered, synthesizes a deterministic stub Repl URL when no live Replit API helper is configured, then crystal-anchors the deploy.

replit:mint_token_on_deploy.behaviour: chain='solana' (default) routes to core.lib.third_party.solana_mcp.SolanaMCPConnector.send('mint_token_2022', svg_data_uri_b64=svg_payload_b64, persona_id=..., confirm=False). chain='sui' falls back to core.lib.third_party.sui_mcp.nft_mint(package='TROLLN'). Both paths return shaped dicts even when the connector, CLI, or module is missing — the bridge never crashes the deploy pipeline.
replit:mint_token_on_deploy.log: tier='monetization', model='replit_mint_solana' (or 'replit_mint_sui' on Sui fallback), scope='token_minted_on_deploy'

replit:link_snap_lens_to_repl.behaviour: Persists {repl_url: {lens_id, persona_filter, ts}} to studio/mcp/replit-bridge/lens_routes.json. Builds the Snap Camera Kit deeplink via core.lib.third_party.snap_camera_kit.SnapCameraKitConnector.send('lens_deeplink_url', ...). When the connector is unavailable falls back to a stdlib-built snapchat://camera?lens=<id>&hint=<persona> deeplink.

added_helpers: _replit_inference_logger() — lazy InferenceLogger factory; returns None on failure
_replit_log(tier, model, scope, prompt, output) — single crystal-anchor entry point for the three tools
_replit_load_workflow_card(slug) — reads studio/assets/_workflows/<slug>.json with two fallback candidates
_replit_call_existing_generate_app(card, repl_name) — re-uses generate_app if already registered, else returns a stub package manifest
_replit_synth_repl_url(repl_name) — deterministic SHA1-based stub Repl URL when the real Replit API helper is absent
_replit_mint_via_solana(persona_id, svg_payload_b64) — Solana Token-2022 mint via SolanaMCPConnector
_replit_mint_via_sui(persona_id, svg_payload_b64) — Sui NFT mint via TROLLN package
_replit_mint_token_on_deploy(repl_url, persona_id, svg_payload_b64, chain) — handler for replit:mint_token_on_deploy
_replit_snap_deeplink(lens_id, persona_filter) — deeplink builder, real connector preferred, stdlib stub fallback

added_constants._REPLIT_MORPH_TSCN: studio/godot/scenes/morphing_game.tscn (referenced by the deploy package manifest)
added_constants._REPLIT_MORPH_RUNTIME: core/lib/morph_game_runtime.py (parallel-build by agent G, contains ScenePlan)

added_files.studio/mcp/replit-bridge/lens_routes.jso: Empty JSON object on first touch; populated by replit:link_snap_lens_to_repl. stdlib-json only, no schema migration needed.

substrate: additive — no own DB, no new dependencies beyond stdlib + whatever server.py already imports. Reuses the existing FastAPI POST /tools/{tool_name} route, the existing TOOLS dispatch dict, core/lib/inference_logger crystal anchors, and lazy-imports the three parallel-build connectors (morph_game_runtime, solana_mcp, snap_camera_kit, optional sui_mcp).
